DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 引継ぎのメモを一緒に読みましょう。内容で確かめたいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's read the handover note together. Is there anything you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 利用者さんが「今日は静かな場所で過ごしたい」と話したとありますが、いつの話かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用者の発言の時刻がわからないことを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says the service user said, 'I want to spend today somewhere quiet,' but I don't know when they said it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that the time of the service user's statement is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時刻が書かれていませんね。記入した職員へ確認します。その言葉から、ほかに何か読み取れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: No time is written. I'll check with the staff who recorded it. Did you learn anything else from those words?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 理由や今の様子まではわかりません。元気がないと決めつけず、書かれている言葉だけ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 理由と今の状態を推測せず発言を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't know the reason or their current condition. Rather than assume they're feeling low, I'd like to pass on only the recorded words.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Pass on the statement without guessing the reason or current condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できたことと推測を分けましょう。今の様子については、担当者が確認した内容を聞いてから引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate confirmed facts from guesses. We'll hand over the current condition after hearing what the responsible staff checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者の確認を待ちます。私は今日、どこまで担当するのか、業務の一覧も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 状態の確認を待ちながら業務一覧を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait for their confirmation. Could you also show me the duty list so I know the extent of my responsibilities today?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the duty list while waiting for confirmation of the person's condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの一覧で確認しましょう。担当が不明な項目は、自分で引き受けず私に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check this list. If responsibility for an item is unclear, ask me instead of taking it on yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この項目は担当者の名前が空欄です。私の担当なのか判断できないので、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の業務か判断できない項目の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The responsible person's name is blank for this item. I can't tell whether it's my duty, so please check.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for confirmation of an item you cannot identify as your own duty. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 空欄の担当は私が確認します。報告するときは、利用者さんの言葉、わからない時刻、担当の空欄を分けて伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the blank assignment. When reporting, separate the service user's words, the unknown time, and the blank assignment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 言葉をそのまま伝え、時刻と担当は未確認だと報告します。確認できるまで、自分の判断で担当範囲を広げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発言と未確認の時刻や担当を区別して引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report their exact words and that the time and responsibility are unconfirmed. Until checked, I won't expand my responsibilities by my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the statement from unconfirmed time and responsibility in the handover. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その整理で引き継ぎましょう。私は記入者と担当者へ確認してきます。ここまでの確認、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's hand over with that distinction. I'll check with the writer and responsible staff. Thank you for the checks so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの棚をご検討ですね。置く場所の寸法は測っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're considering this shelf. Have you measured where it will go?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 壁の幅は測りました。この棚なら置けそうですが、配送を頼めるかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 壁の幅を測った棚の配送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've measured the wall width. This shelf seems to fit, but I'd also like to ask about delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about delivery of a shelf after measuring the wall width. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送の相談に加えて、運び込む経路も確認しましょう。玄関や途中の通路の幅はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides delivery, let's check the route for bringing it inside. Do you know the entrance and passage widths?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋の中しか測っていません。玄関からすぐ曲がるので、その部分が心配になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 玄関の曲がる場所をまだ測っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've only measured inside the room. There's a turn immediately after the entrance, so now I'm concerned about that part.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't measured the turning area at the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 曲がる場所も含めて測ると確認しやすいです。棚は外箱に入る場合もあるので、梱包時の寸法も調べますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Measuring the turning area too will help. The shelf may arrive in an outer box, so I'll check packed dimensions as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品そのものの幅だけでは足りないのですね。測る場所を紙にまとめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 梱包寸法と家で測る場所を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the product's width alone isn't enough. Could you list the places I should measure on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize packed dimensions and places to measure at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 玄関と通路、曲がる場所などを書きます。建物内の搬入について管理者へ確認することもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll write entrance, passage, turns, and so on. You may also need to check building delivery access with the manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理者にも相談します。配送日を先に決めるのではなく、寸法と搬入の条件がわかってから申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者と寸法の確認後に配送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the manager too. Rather than fix a delivery date first, may I apply once I know the dimensions and access conditions?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about delivery after checking dimensions and the manager's conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に候補日や費用を含めてご相談できます。今は配送の可否を決めず、必要な情報を集めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we can discuss possible dates and cost. For now, let's gather information rather than decide whether delivery is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は注文せず、測る場所と梱包寸法を持ち帰ります。管理者にも聞いてから配送を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文前に経路と建物の条件を調べ直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't order today; I'll take the measurement list and packed dimensions home. I'll ask about delivery after checking with the manager too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Recheck the access route and building conditions before ordering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた情報と棚の品番をお持ちください。次のご相談で照らし合わせましょう。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring the confirmed information and shelf product number. We'll compare them at the next consultation. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 測定の準備を始めます。部品の作業票と図面を手元にそろえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll begin measurement preparations. Have the part's work sheet and drawing ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そろえましたが、作業票には改訂二、図面には改訂一とあります。このまま測ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業票と図面の改訂番号が違うまま測ってよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have them, but the work sheet says revision two and the drawing revision one. May I measure as they are?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether measurement can proceed with differing revision numbers on the work sheet and drawing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま進めず、使用する図面を確認します。部品の番号も作業票と一致しているか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't proceed as they are; we'll check which drawing to use. Please also check the part number matches the work sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部品の番号は一致しています。図面の版だけ違うので、測定はまだ始めずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部品番号は合うが測定を始めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The part number matches. Only the drawing revision differs, so I won't start measuring yet; I'll wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the part number matches but you won't begin measurement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 責任者へ版の確認を頼みます。待つ間は、測定器の名称と置き場所を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the supervisor to confirm the revision. While waiting, let's check the measuring instrument's name and location together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 測定器の準備だけ行います。隣の機械が止まっていますが、部品を取り出すために操作してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備中に止まった機械へ触れてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll only prepare the measuring instrument. The machine next to it is stopped; may I operate it to remove a part?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you may touch the stopped machine during preparation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あなたの今日の担当は測定の練習です。機械には触れず、操作が必要な場合は担当者を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your duty today is measurement practice. Don't touch the machine; call the responsible person if operation is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当外の機械には触れません。測定器にも見慣れない表示がありますが、設定を変えずに見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械に触れず設定不明の測定器を先輩に見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't touch machinery outside my assignment. The measuring instrument also has an unfamiliar display. Could you look without my changing the settings?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the machine untouched and show the senior an instrument with unclear settings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が表示を確認します。図面と測定器の確認が両方済んでから、測る手順を実演しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the display. Once both drawing and instrument checks are done, I'll demonstrate the measurement procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図面の版と測定器の表示の確認を待ちます。実演を受けてから測定し、機械操作は担当者へ頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料と表示の確認と実演後に測定へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for confirmation of the drawing revision and instrument display. I'll measure after the demonstration and ask the responsible person for machine operation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed to measurement after document and display confirmation and demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 開始前に違いに気づけてよかったです。私は責任者と確認してきますので、そのまま準備場所でお待ちください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's good you noticed the difference before starting. I'll check with the supervisor, so stay at the preparation area and wait. Thank you for your efforts.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文を伺う前に、メニューで気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before taking your order, is there anything on the menu you want to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お好み焼きを食べたいのですが、鉄板で自分で焼くのでしょうか。初めてなので上手に焼けるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めてなので自分で焼く必要があるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like okonomiyaki, but do I cook it myself on the griddle? It's my first time and I'm worried I won't cook it well.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to cook it yourself because it's your first time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この席では、私が焼いたものをお出しする注文にできます。具材の希望も伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this table, you can order it cooked by me. Would you also like to discuss ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼いていただけるなら安心です。メニューの二種類は、具材がどう違うのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 焼いてもらう注文を希望し二種類を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That puts me at ease. Please explain how the ingredients differ between these two menu items.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a staff-cooked order and compare the two types. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは豚肉入り、もう一つはイカ入りです。詳しい具材はメニューの説明でも確かめましょう。味付けは、ソースを後から加える形がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This has pork, and the other squid. Let's also check detailed ingredients in the menu description. Would you prefer to add sauce afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で少しずつ加えたいです。ソースとマヨネーズは別に出してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調味料を少しずつ加えるため別添えを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to add it gradually myself. Could you serve the sauce and mayonnaise separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for condiments separately so you can add a little at a time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別添えの希望を確認します。料理は切ってお出しするか、そのままお出しするかも伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check your request for separate condiments. We can also ask whether you want the dish cut or served whole.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食べやすい大きさに切っていただきたいです。熱い鉄板は、自分で動かさずにお願いしたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を切ってもらい鉄板の移動は任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please cut it into easy-to-eat pieces. I should ask you rather than move the hot griddle myself, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have the dish cut and leave griddle movement to the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鉄板を動かす必要があれば呼んでください。ご希望は、こちらで焼き、切って、調味料を別に添える形ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Call us if the griddle needs moving. You want us to cook it, cut it, and serve condiments separately, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その形でお願いします。具材の説明を聞いた二種類から、こちらのメニューを一つ注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提供方法と調味料を確認して候補から一つ選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. From the two types whose ingredients you explained, I'll order one of this menu item.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm serving method and condiments and choose one from the options. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。調味料の希望も確認してから焼き始めます。出来上がりまでお待ちください。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We'll check your condiment preferences before starting to cook. Please wait until it's ready. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。どの部分が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about notices. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つ届いたので、同じ税を二回請求されたのか心配です。どちらもこちらで相談できるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ税の重複かと思い相談可能な窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received two and worry I've been billed twice for the same tax. Can I ask about both here?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Worried about duplicate billing for the same tax, ask which counter can advise. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず表題と発行元を見比べましょう。同じものと決めつけず、それぞれの通知を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First let's compare titles and issuers. We'll check each notice rather than assume they're the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく見ると発行元が違います。片方の表題は読めますが、もう片方は意味がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 違う発行元と理解できない表題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking closely, the issuers differ. I can read one title, but don't understand the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the different issuers and title you don't understand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を確認する担当先も分けて調べましょう。通知には問い合わせ先が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also find the responsible contact for each separately. Are inquiry contacts listed on the notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏面に連絡先があります。電話する際、通知のどの情報を手元に用意すればよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏面の連絡先へ相談するための情報を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are contacts on the back. I'd like to know which information to have at hand when calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what information to prepare for consulting the contact on the back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当先が内容を確認できるよう、通知を手元に置いて相談すると伝えやすいです。気になる箇所も印を付けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keeping the notice at hand will help you explain so the responsible office can check the contents. Mark the concerning sections too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額だけでなく対象の期間も聞きたいです。わからない通知を処分せず、二つとも持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額と対象期間を二つの通知で確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to ask about the covered periods, not just the amounts. I won't discard the notice I don't understand; I'll bring both for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the amounts and covered periods on both notices. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま保管してください。担当外の内容は確認先をご案内しますが、ここで支払いの要否を断定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep them as they are. For matters outside our responsibility we'll direct you to the relevant contact, but can't determine payment necessity here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二重請求と決めず、表題と発行元と期間をそれぞれ確認します。担当先を聞き、支払いについても通知を見せて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複と決めつけず通知ごとに支払いの疑問を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Rather than decide it's duplicate billing, I'll check each title, issuer, and period. I'll ask the relevant contacts and show the notices when discussing payment too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check payment questions notice by notice without assuming duplication. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談する点が整理できましたね。発行元ごとの確認先を調べますので、お待ちください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your consultation points are organized now. We'll find the contact for each issuer, so please wait. Thank you for consulting us today.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕分けを始める前に札を見てください。行き先の印が読めない箱はありませんか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before sorting, look at the tags. Are there boxes whose destination marks you can't read?

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 奥の箱の札が濡れていて、丸印か三角印かわかりません。魚の種類で判断してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた札の印が判別できないと伝え魚の種類で判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The tag on the back box is wet, and I can't tell circle from triangle. May I judge from the fish species?
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a wet tag's mark is unreadable and ask whether fish species can determine the destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 種類だけで行き先は決められません。その箱は今の位置に置いたまま、ほかの箱と混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Species alone can't determine the destination. Leave that box in place and don't mix it with the others.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その箱は動かしません。隣の箱は札が読めますが、先にそちらを量ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不明の箱は動かさず隣の札が読める箱を先に量れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't move it. I can read the neighboring box's tag; may I weigh that one first?
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Leave the unclear box and ask to weigh a neighboring box with a readable tag first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読める箱から進めましょう。ただ、まだ計量担当が来ていないので、はかりには載せず札の番号を控えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's proceed with readable boxes. But the weighing staff haven't arrived, so don't put it on the scale; note the tag number instead.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札の番号を控えます。読めない箱にも仮の番号を書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読める番号を控えると答え不明の箱に仮番号を付けてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note the tag number. May I also write a temporary number on the unreadable box?
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will note readable numbers and ask whether to give the unclear box a temporary number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自分で番号を付けず、私に位置を教えてください。元の記録と照合してから札を直します。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't assign a number yourself; tell me its location. We'll correct the tag after matching the original record.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から見て右奥の箱です。すぐ前に空の箱があるので、それと取り違えないようお伝えします。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口から右奥で手前に空箱があるという位置関係を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's at the back right as seen from the entrance. There's an empty box just in front, so I'm explaining that to avoid a mix-up.
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the location as back right from the entrance, with an empty box in front. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置がわかりました。記録を確認してきます。計量担当には、まだ量っていないことも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: I know the location now. I'll check the records. Also tell the weighing staff it hasn't been weighed yet.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を控えた箱も未計量だと伝えます。右奥の箱は照合が終わるまで仕分けから外しておきます。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号記録済みでも未計量と知らせ不明の箱を照合まで仕分けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say even boxes with recorded numbers remain unweighed. I'll keep the back-right box out of sorting until the comparison is finished.
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say recorded numbers don't mean weighing is done, and keep the unclear box unsorted until matched. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻ったら箱を一緒に確認しましょう。それでは、番号の記録をお願いします。またこちらで声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-KCH-SUSAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the boxes together when I return. Please record the numbers for now. I'll speak to you again here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど二つと伺いましたが、串を二本というご注文でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You said two earlier. Is that an order for two skewers?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、二人分というつもりでした。一人二本ずつなので、全部で四本お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人が二本ずつ食べるので合計四本だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I meant for two people. Two each, so four skewers altogether, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say two people will eat two skewers each, totaling four. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 四本ですね。同じ味を四本にしますか、それともお二人で違う味を選びますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Four, then. All the same flavor, or different flavors for each of you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 塩味を二本と、たれ味を二本にします。塩味の方は持ち帰り、たれ味の方はここで食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 塩二本は持ち帰りでたれ二本はその場で食べると指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two salt-flavored and two sauce-flavored. The salt ones are takeaway; we'd like to eat the sauce ones here.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify two salt skewers for takeaway and two sauce skewers to eat here. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食べる場所も別なのですね。持ち帰り分は包みます。会計を一緒にするか、別にするか決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the eating locations differ too. We'll wrap the takeaway portion. Have you decided whether payment is combined or separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人分を私がまとめて払います。連れが席を探しているので、呼んでから受け取ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分が二人分払い席を探す連れを呼んでから受け取ると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll pay for both of us together. My companion is looking for seats; may I collect after calling them back?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will pay for two and ask to collect after calling your seat-finding companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 席が決まってからお呼びいただければ、ここで食べる分をお渡しします。持ち帰り分の袋に味を書いておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Call us once your seats are settled and we'll hand over the eat-in portion. Shall we write the flavor on the takeaway bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 塩味と書いてください。四本のうち包む二本と、すぐ食べる二本を取り違えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 塩味の記載を頼み包む二本とその場の二本を区別したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please write salt. I want to avoid confusing the two wrapped skewers with the two we'll eat right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a salt label and explain wanting to distinguish the wrapped two from the eat-in two. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 塩味二本を包み、たれ味二本をそのままお渡しする注文で記録します。数はこれで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record two salt skewers wrapped and two sauce skewers served as they are. Is that the right count?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その四本です。連れを呼んでから、まとめた会計の金額を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四本の注文を確認し連れを呼んだ後にまとめた金額を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, those four. I'll call my companion, then ask for the combined total.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the four-skewer order and say you will ask for the total after calling your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二人分ではなく本数で確認できてよかったです。それでは、お連れの方が戻られたらこちらでお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's good we checked skewers rather than portions for two people. We'll wait here for your companion's return.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当の棚をご覧ですね。温めて召し上がる物をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the bento shelves. Are you looking for something to heat before eating?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤の休憩に食べる物を探しています。今は温めずに持って行きたいのですが、この二つは食べ方が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤の休憩用で今は温めず持参したいと説明し二商品の食べ方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Something for a night-shift break. I'd like to take it without heating now. Do these two have different eating instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain it's for a night-shift break without heating now and ask how the two products differ in use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは温め方の表示があり、もう一方はそのまま食べる案内です。職場で温める設備は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This has heating instructions, while the other says eat as is. Can you use heating facilities at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休憩室の電子レンジは使えますが、容器ごと入れてよいかがわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場の電子レンジは使えるが容器ごと入れられるか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can use the break room microwave, but don't know whether the container can go in as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the workplace microwave is available but you don't know whether the container can go in. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習用商品の表示では、ふたを外す説明があります。使うときは表示を読み直してからにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This practice product's label says to remove the lid. When using it, reread the label first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ふたを外す表示ですね。休憩まで時間があるので、職場で置いておく場所も確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふたを外す表示を確認し休憩までの保管場所を調べてから選びたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says remove the lid, right? There's time until my break, so I'd like to check workplace storage before choosing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the remove-lid label and say you want to check storage until the break before choosing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管については、この表示欄をご確認ください。購入後にその条件に合う場所へ置けるかが大切ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: For storage, please check this label section. It's important whether you can keep it somewhere meeting those conditions after buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場の保管場所がまだ確認できていません。今日はそのまま食べる方を、帰宅後の食事用に買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場の保管先が未確認なので帰宅後に食べる商品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't confirmed workplace storage yet. Today I'll buy the ready-to-eat one for a meal after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say workplace storage is unconfirmed and choose a product to eat after going home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用途を変えるのですね。夜勤用は、設備と保管場所を確認してから選ぶということでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You're changing the purpose, then. You'll choose the night-shift meal after checking facilities and storage, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夜勤用は次回にします。今日はこの一つだけ買い、ここでは温めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜勤用は後日にし一つだけ購入して温めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave night-shift food until next time. Just this one today, and please don't heat it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Postpone the night-shift purchase, buy one item, and request no heating. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 温めずに一つお会計します。表示は召し上がる前にもご覧ください。それでは、お仕事もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ring up one without heating. Check the label again before eating too. Take care at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物用のお茶をお探しですか。お相手は普段どのようにお茶を入れていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for tea as a gift? How does the recipient normally make tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人はマグカップだけ持っています。急須がなくても入れられる物を贈りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: マグカップだけの友人に急須不要のお茶を贈りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend only has a mug. I'd like to give tea they can make without a teapot.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want teapot-free tea for a friend with only a mug. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の商品なら、袋をカップに入れる型があります。茶葉だけの商品より道具をそろえずに使えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice product includes a type with bags you put into a cup. It needs fewer tools than loose leaves.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋入りにします。大きな一袋より、一回ずつ開けられる包みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋入りを選び大袋より一回ずつ開ける包みを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll choose tea bags. Rather than one big bag, do you have individually opened portions?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose bagged tea and ask for individual portions rather than a large bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個別に包んだ物がこちらです。入れ方の説明も箱にありますが、贈るときに簡単なメモを添えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are individually wrapped ones. Brewing instructions are also on the box; would you like to add a short note with the gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メモを添えたいです。お湯の量と、袋を取り出すまでの時間をどこで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 添え書き用に湯量と袋を取り出す時間の確認箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like a note. Where can I check the amount of water and the time before taking the bag out?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to check water quantity and steeping time for the accompanying note. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱の裏の入れ方の欄に書いてあります。この商品の表示をそのまま見られるよう、包みで隠さない方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: They're in the brewing section on the back. We can also wrap it without hiding the product instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を読めるように包んでください。飲み終えるまで、残りの包みの置き場所についても伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示が読める包装を依頼し残りの包みの置き場所も伝えたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please wrap it so the label can be read. I'd also like to explain where to store the remaining portions until they're all used.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request readable-label wrapping and say you want to explain storage for the remaining portions too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存の欄も一緒にメモするとよいですね。開ける前と開けた後の説明を分けて読んでみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Noting the storage section as well would be good. Let's read pre-opening and post-opening instructions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入れ方と保存の欄を分けて読み、個別の包みを使うこともメモします。この箱を贈り物に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入れ方と保存を分けて読み個別包装を使うメモを添えて箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read brewing and storage separately and note that individual packets are used. I'll choose this box as the gift.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read brewing and storage separately, add a note about individual packets, and choose the box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を隠さず贈れるよう整えます。お相手にも読みやすいメモになりますね。それでは、出来上がりまで少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll arrange it so you can give it without hiding the label. The note should be easy for your friend to read too. Please wait a moment while it's prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は最初に作業の様子を見てもらいます。まだ柵の内側には入らず、ここで話を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: First today, you'll observe the work. Don't enter inside the fence yet; listen here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 牛の近くで見た方がわかると思いましたが、まず外側から見るのですね。どの位置で待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外側から見ることを確かめ具体的な待つ位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought seeing close to the cattle would help, but we look from outside first, right? Where should I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm observing from outside and ask the specific waiting position. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習場面では、私が示す白い線の後ろで待ちます。荷物を柵に掛けてはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this practice scenario, wait behind the white line I indicate. You haven't hung your belongings on the fence, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肩からかばんを下げています。牛舎へ持って入るより、外の棚へ置いた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肩のかばんを牛舎に持ち込まず棚に置く方がよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My bag is over my shoulder. Should I put it on the outside shelf rather than carry it into the cowshed?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether to put your shoulder bag on the shelf rather than bring it into the cowshed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指定の棚に置いてから戻ってください。作業用の道具はまだ持たず、手順の説明から始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put it on the designated shelf, then return. Don't take working tools yet; we'll begin with the procedure explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを棚に置きます。見学の途中で牛がこちらへ動いてきた場合、私も位置を変えて追いかけてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を置くと答え牛の動きに合わせて追ってよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put it on the shelf. If a cow moves toward us during observation, may I change position and follow it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll put the bag away and ask whether to follow the cow's movement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追いかけず、ここから私を呼んでください。観察位置を変えるときはこちらから声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't follow; call me from here. I'll tell you when to change observation positions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追いかけずに声を掛けます。手伝ってほしいと言われたら、説明を聞いてから道具を持つ順番ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追わず呼ぶと確認し作業依頼時は説明後に道具を持つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call rather than follow. If asked to help, is the order to hear the explanation before picking up tools?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm calling instead of following and ask whether to take tools after explanation when assigned work. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番で進めます。説明後も不明なことがあれば、取り掛かる前に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll follow that order. Even after explanation, ask before starting if anything remains unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見学中は指定の位置を守り、作業を頼まれたら手順を確認してから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察位置を守り依頼された作業は手順確認後に始めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep to the observation position and start assigned work only after checking the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep the observation position and begin requested work after confirming the procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、荷物を置いたら線の後ろへ戻ってきてください。それでは、牛舎の入口でまた説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then put your belongings away and return behind the line. I'll explain again at the cowshed entrance.
